detail_seo_description: Door-type display frames supplied as hardware, printed graphics or complete sets. Dimensions and installation requirements depend on the selected model.

detail.lead: A door-type display stand uses a doorway-style frame to create a freestanding display area. It can be used for event entrances, backdrop graphics and indoor promotions. Hardware, printed graphics or a complete configuration can be supplied to suit the project.
highlights: Hardware and printed graphics can be specified separately
Graphic fit is confirmed against the selected frame design
Dimensions, connections and accessories depend on the model
finishing: Hardware and graphics combined to the confirmed configuration
delivery: Hardware and graphics may be packed separately by order
Complete configurations follow the confirmed frame and component list
Packing and freight are assessed by order volume, quantity and destination
detail.artwork: Please provide artwork after the frame and graphic dimensions are confirmed. If the graphic requires panels or sections, confirm the layout and installation orientation before production. Basic file checks and minor adjustments can be assisted; extensive changes or original design are confirmed separately.
detail.brief: Please share the installation setting, overall dimensions or a reference image, quantity, whether you need hardware and printed graphics, artwork, installation method and destination.
detail.caveat: Door-type stands may use different frame constructions, connectors and graphic attachment methods. Dimensions, stability requirements, installation conditions and transport packing must be confirmed for the selected model and intended environment.
